profile.org_note: Betenbough Homes, LLC is wholly owned by Betenbough Companies, PBC, a Texas public benefit corporation that is 100% employee-owned through an ESOP and run by a CEO (Jeanna Roach) and a small executive board (Brad Nelson, Cal Zant, Kerry Ritchie). Inside the builder: President Cal Zant, then VP Operations Corey Lusk, then area directors, then general managers per region, with an in-house Land Development department in each of the four markets. Accounting sits in the shared-services affiliate Betenbough Business Services. There is no published CFO or head of land, so the land and finance decision-makers to approach are Cal Zant and Brad Nelson (the latter by inference).
profile.summary: A conventional for-sale, entry-level and move-up single-family builder working only in four West Texas markets (Lubbock, Midland, Odessa, Amarillo), where it says it is the number one builder; more than 20,000 homes delivered since 1992. It prices cost-plus, develops its own land through in-house land development teams and asks landowners to bring it tracts directly. It is unusual in ownership: 100% ESOP-owned through a faith-driven public benefit corporation with no outside equity, and with co-founder Rick Betenbough's death around the turn of 2023-24 and Ron Betenbough's on 28 August 2024, decisions now rest with a non-family CEO and executive board. A plausible but unproven land-banking customer: nothing public shows any off-balance-sheet lot financing today.

gaps: CFO / finance head: no CFO, controller or treasurer title is publicly disclosed. The former finance director (Paul Boecker) left in Sept 2023; his successor is not named. Brad Nelson (executive board) appears to oversee finance and the affiliates, by inference only.

Head of land (VP or Director of Land, Land Acquisition): not publicly disclosed. Land Development is an in-house department in all four markets; the most senior titles found are Land Development Manager and Land Planning Manager, both from a third-party directory.

Midland General Manager and Odessa General Manager: current holders not found (Roy Sanders moved to a Midland developer role and Lora Robertson was promoted to Midland/Odessa area director during 2025).
Lubbock Southwest region and Amarillo area development manager: leaders not found.
Charlie Cooke (Midland/Odessa Area Director on the Nov 2024 team page) left out: Lora Robertson now holds that title and no newer source places him.
